cases.description: Three ducts get the comment 'mc-live-edit'; after the value cache drops (as DocumentChanged does) the rule Comments equals 'mc-live-edit' counts 3 instead of 0
manualSteps: Check only 'Current model'; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, + Condition Comments equals mc-live-edit: count 0.
Select three ducts and type mc-live-edit in Comments (Properties): the count becomes 3 without any click in the panel.
Undo the edit (Ctrl+Z): the count returns to 0.

cases.description: A copied duct is counted after the cache drops; before that the candidates stay as they were
manualSteps: Check only 'Current model'; Filter tab: + New filter, Categories Ducts, no rules: note the count n.
Copy one duct (Modify > Copy): the count becomes n + 1.
Undo the copy: the count returns to n.
